test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The 'DigiGaon' initiative was launched by the ______ Department.

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'DigiGaon' initiative** was launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
 
• This initiative aims to provide various digital services such as **telemedicine, education, and skills** through digital means to rural areas.
 
• The primary objective is to **bridge the digital divide** and enhance the quality of life in rural regions by leveraging technology.
 
• The initiative is part of the broader **Digital India program** which seeks to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Digital India program** was launched by the Government of India in **July 2015**.
 
• It aims to ensure that government services are made available to citizens electronically by improving online infrastructure and increasing Internet connectivity.
 
• One of the major components of the Digital India initiative is to **connect rural areas with high-speed internet networks**.
 
• The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology is responsible for formulating and implementing policies related to **information technology, electronics, and the internet**.
 
• The **'DigiGaon' initiative** is a step towards achieving the vision of Digital India by ensuring that the benefits of technology reach the remotest parts of the country.
